entries.back_en: But I can't leave my men behind. I think splitting up is like what General Brigard would do in this situation.
entries.note: 'faria' (would do) for 'would suggest' is a minor shift but conveys the sense.

entries.back_en: No... Forget it. Make this worth it. But do me a favor... Save my men and tell General Brigard I'm sorry...
entries.note: Accurate, casual tone preserved with codes intact.

entries.back_en: You are both beyond forgiveness. The question is... Now that you've chosen this path, how will you die here?
Congratulations on making it this far. If you want to live, you have to answer correctly: What will you lose before leaving this room?
You!!! Careful, soldier. You almost took a big axe to the head. We can't let our guard down in this situation.
entries.note: Accurate; 'machadão' adds slight augmentative but fine.

entries.back_en: They raised me not to take what isn't mine, but maybe we should... And you, what do you think?
entries.note: Sense preserved; 'Criaram eu' is colloquial but fits tone.
